label: Istanbul + Tanzania · Jan 12
title: Istanbul & Tanzania: Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Mikumi and the Udzungwa rainforest
summary: Istanbul 3n, then a private 6-day northern camping safari (Tarangire walk + night drive, Serengeti ×3, crater) and a 4-day Mikumi + Udzungwa trip from Dar. ~$5,820 pp.
overview:
- **Dates:** LAX Sat Dec 26 → LAX Tue Jan 12. 17 nights: 3 Istanbul, 13 Tanzania, 1 on a plane.
- **Route:** Istanbul 3n → Arusha 1n → **6-day northern camping safari** (Tarangire, Serengeti 3n, Ngorongoro rim, crater) → Arusha 1n → fly to Dar → **4-day Mikumi + Udzungwa** → home from Dar.
- **Why Istanbul Dec 30, not Dec 31:** one fewer paid hotel night and day of food (~$95 pp), and the trip ends a day sooner. Istanbul is on Tanzania time, so the jet lag is handled there; the Dec 31 Arusha day only has to absorb the 01:40 landing.
- **Why Udzungwa and Mikumi:** Udzungwa is real Eastern Arc rainforest with 12 primate species, two of them found nowhere else (Udzungwa red colobus, Sanje mangabey). Mikumi is the savanna next door: a second, quiet big-game park.
- **Big 5:** lion, elephant, buffalo near-certain; leopard gets three Serengeti days plus Mikumi; rhino rests on the Ngorongoro crater.
- **On foot and after dark:** the northern safari is private, so day 1 in Tarangire adds a ranger-led walking safari and a night drive. Most Tanzanian parks (Serengeti, Ngorongoro) ban night drives; Tarangire is one of the few that allow them. Udzungwa is a full day on foot, and a Mikumi walk + night drive is an option.
- **Budget: ~$5,820 pp**, ~$365 more than the shared-group version, with **no contingency**. The private safari and the Tarangire walk + night drive add ~$475; switching insurance to medical + evacuation takes back $110. The northern safari is 6 days (Lake Manyara cut) and Istanbul ends Dec 30.

itinerary.title: Fly toward Istanbul
itinerary.details: TK10 LAX 19:45 → IST 19:00 next day (~13h). Istanbul is on Tanzania time (UTC+3), so the jet-lag shift is done once, here.

itinerary.title: Land Istanbul, metro into the city
itinerary.details: Land 19:00. Metro M11 → M2 → T1 to Sultanahmet, ~1.5h door to door. Buy an Istanbulkart at the station. Easy dinner, early night.

itinerary.title: Sultanahmet on foot
itinerary.details: Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, the Basilica Cistern — all within ten minutes of each other. Zero travel.

itinerary.title: Topkapı, Grand Bazaar, Bosphorus
itinerary.details: Topkapı in the morning, Grand Bazaar after lunch, then a public ferry to Kadıköy on the Asian side for dinner.

itinerary.title: Free morning, fly to Kilimanjaro
itinerary.details: Spice Bazaar or Süleymaniye. Bags at the hotel. Leave for the airport by 15:00. TK Istanbul 18:30 → Kilimanjaro 01:40 (summer 2026 timing; confirm the Dec schedule).

itinerary.title: Land 01:40, rest day in Arusha
itinerary.details: Visa check at JRO, pre-booked taxi to Arusha (~1h). Room held from Dec 30 so it's ready at 03:00. Sleep in, then a slow day: Tanzanian SIM, cash, meet the safari operator for the briefing. Quiet New Year's Eve.

itinerary.title: Safari day 1: Tarangire on foot and after dark
itinerary.details: Pickup ~07:00, ~2.5h to Tarangire. Late-morning drive: big elephant herds, baobabs, lion. Mid-afternoon, a 2–3h walking safari with an armed TANAPA ranger, on foot among elephant, giraffe and zebra. After dinner, a night drive (TANAPA window 19:00–23:00) with a spotlight: bushbaby, genet, civet, porcupine, and a chance of leopard or lion hunting. Camp at the Tarangire public campsite.

itinerary.title: Safari day 2: into the Serengeti
itinerary.details: Up over the Ngorongoro highlands (rim forest views), down through Ngorongoro conservation area to Naabi Hill gate, game drive to Seronera. ~6–7h with driving and drives. In January the herds are on the southern short-grass plains, so you may cross them on the way in.

itinerary.title: Safari day 3: leopard day
itinerary.details: Zero transfer. Dawn to dusk in the Seronera valley: the sausage trees and kopjes are the best leopard country on the circuit. Lion and cheetah are routine here.

itinerary.title: Safari day 4: the herds or more cats
itinerary.details: Zero transfer. Ask the guide on day 2 whether a run toward the southern plains / Ndutu edge is worth it this year; otherwise a second full Seronera day for leopard.

itinerary.title: Safari day 5: last drive, up to the rim
itinerary.details: Morning drive, then ~3h to Simba campsite on the crater rim (2,300 m — cold; buffalo and elephant wander through camp at night).

itinerary.title: Safari day 6: crater floor for rhino
itinerary.details: Descend at gate opening (~06:00) for the full 6h crater allowance: black rhino (the best chance on the trip), lion, hyena, flamingo. Out by midday, ~4h back to Arusha.

itinerary.title: Fly south to Dar
itinerary.details: Precision Air or Air Tanzania, Arusha (ARK) or Kilimanjaro (JRO) → Dar, ~1h15 direct. Afternoon off; laundry. Meet the Mikumi–Udzungwa operator.

itinerary.title: South trip day 1: Mikumi
itinerary.details: Operator pickup. SGR train to Morogoro (~1.5h) then road to Mikumi, or ~5h by road. Afternoon game drive: elephant, giraffe, buffalo, hippo pools, lion.

itinerary.title: South trip day 2: full day in Mikumi
itinerary.details: Zero transfer. Full-day drive on the Mkata floodplain; leopard is possible in the wooded hills. Few vehicles compared with the north. Option: a ranger-led morning walk and a night drive here too.

itinerary.title: South trip day 3: rainforest on foot
itinerary.details: ~1.5h to Mang'ula. Full day hiking with a park guide: Sanje Falls trail (170 m falls, ~5–6h), with a primate-focused walk for the Udzungwa (Iringa) red colobus and Sanje crested mangabey. Chameleons, forest birds. Udzungwa is walking-only — no vehicles inside.

itinerary.title: Back to Dar
itinerary.details: Early start, road to Morogoro (~3h) and SGR or road back to Dar. Hotel near the airport with the room until midnight; shower, repack, sleep a few hours.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.details: Leave the hotel ~00:30. TK604 DAR ~03:25 → IST ~11:05, then TK9 → LAX, arriving the same evening. About 27h door to door.

lodging.name: Istanbul hotel (TK Stopover, 2 nights free)
lodging.includes: Room and breakfast. Turkish Airlines gives US-origin economy passengers two free nights, once per ticket — only the third is paid.
lodging.why: Gets the 11h time shift done before Africa; Istanbul is on Tanzania time.
lodging.alternatives: Pay for all three nights and choose your own hotel, about +$180 pp.

lodging.name: Budget hotel, Arusha
lodging.includes: ~$50/room B&B. Night of Dec 31 (room held from Dec 30 for the 01:40 landing) and Jan 6 after the crater.
lodging.why: Most safari operators pick up from Arusha town hotels.
lodging.alternatives: Ask the safari operator; many include a pre- and post-safari Arusha night.

lodging.name: Northern safari campsites (in package)
lodging.includes: Tents, mats, cook and all meals are in the safari price, along with park and campsite fees.
lodging.why: Public campsites inside the Serengeti and on the crater rim put you at the wildlife at dawn — the cheapest way to get there first.
lodging.alternatives: A budget-lodge version of the same route is roughly +$500–800 pp.

lodging.name: Budget hotel, Dar es Salaam
lodging.includes: ~$60/room. Jan 7 in town; Jan 11 near the airport with the room until midnight.
lodging.why: Bracket the southern tour; the operator collects from Dar.

alternatives.name: 7-day safari: add a Lake Manyara day
alternatives.description: Groundwater forest with blue monkeys, baboons and elephants on the way back. Puts the trip ~$200 over the ceiling.

alternatives.name: Stay in Istanbul until Dec 31
alternatives.description: A fourth night (paid) and another day of food. Fare difference unknown until you price it; flying on Dec 31 is sometimes cheaper.

alternatives.name: Second Udzungwa day
alternatives.description: The red colobus and mangabey trails are different from the Sanje Falls route. One more lodge night, guide and park fee.

alternatives.name: Arusha National Park day
alternatives.description: Forest with black-and-white colobus, buffalo, giraffe, and walking safaris with an armed ranger. Fits on Dec 31 only if you skip the rest day.

alternatives.name: Buffer day in Dar before the flight
alternatives.description: Avoids the Udzungwa → Dar → 03:25 flight in one stretch. Home Jan 13.

alternatives.name: Mikumi walking safari + night drive (Jan 9)
alternatives.description: Ranger-led morning walk (~$20–25 + ranger) and a night drive (~$50–59 TANAPA fee + guide time). Mikumi is on TANAPA's night-drive list; ask the tour operator.

alternatives.name: Shared group safari instead of private
alternatives.description: Back to the cheaper fixed-route group safari. Drops the Tarangire walk and night drive, which a shared group can't add.

booking_timeline.task: Price TK multi-city: LAX → IST (stop Dec 27–30) → JRO, and DAR → IST → LAX on Jan 12. Compare against a plain JRO round trip. Confirm the Dec IST → JRO times (summer schedule was 18:30 → 01:40).

Get two quotes for a private 6-day camping safari for 2 starting Jan 1 (Tarangire, Serengeti ×3 at Seronera, Simba rim, crater). Ask for a Jan 1 ranger-led walk and night drive in Tarangire, camping at the Tarangire public campsite, and confirm the operator holds TANAPA night-drive permission. Confirm the crater fee is included.
Book the Mikumi–Udzungwa 4-day for Jan 8–11; ask for the Sanje Falls trail plus a primate walk, and whether they use the SGR to Morogoro.
Book Arusha (Dec 30–31, Jan 6) and Dar (Jan 7, Jan 11) hotels and the Jan 7 Arusha → Dar flight. Book the 02:00 JRO taxi.
Travel clinic: malaria prophylaxis. Yellow fever not required on this routing.
Apply for the TK Stopover hotel (2 free nights).
Tanzania visa at visa.immigration.go.tz ($100, multiple-entry for US citizens). Processing times vary; apply 3–4 weeks ahead.

practical:
## Entry
- **Tanzania:** US citizens need the $100 multiple-entry visa. Apply only at visa.immigration.go.tz; lookalike sites overcharge. Passport 6+ months, 2 blank pages.
- **Yellow fever:** not required arriving from Istanbul. Tanzania asks for it only after >12h transit in a risk country (Kenya counts — don't route via Nairobi).
- Türkiye is visa-free for US tourists.

## Packing
- One soft bag each; the Arusha → Dar flight has tight bag limits.
- **Warm layers for the crater rim** (2,300 m, near freezing at night) and dawn drives. Istanbul is 4–9°C and wet.
- Hiking shoes with grip for the Sanje Falls trail; it's steep and muddy in places. Headtorch for camping.
- Neutral colours; tsetse flies in Tarangire and parts of the Serengeti go for dark blue and black.
- Plastic bags are banned in Tanzania, including in luggage.

## Money
- Park fees are cashless and paid by the operator. Carry crisp post-2013 USD for tips and the visa backup; TZS for meals and taxis.

## Season
- Early January is the short dry spell between rains. Wildebeest herds are on the southern Serengeti / Ndutu plains, with calving from late January.

## Health
- Malaria prophylaxis from before arrival through 7 days after (atovaquone-proguanil). DEET or picaridin.
- Re-check the State Dept Tanzania advisory before paying deposits.

Dec 30–31: 18:30 flight landing 01:40; Dec 31 is a full rest day to recover.
